LanguageData.SCS_StartingPointsTip: Cornerstone points every new colony starts with. Existing saves are not affected.
LanguageData.SCS_GrantSkippedEras: Add points for eras skipped by the starting tech level
LanguageData.SCS_GrantSkippedErasTip: Also grants the points the era advancements up to your starting tech level would have given: 1 for neolithic, 2 for medieval, 3 for industrial, 4 for spacer, 5 for ultra. These are added on top of the starting points.
